_note: Buyer archetypes rendered by the site's Buyer Fit page. Each archetype must recognize itself. No pricing strategy is exposed here; see BUYER_LOGIC.md for the seller-side reasoning.

archetypes.label: Coaching & Development Platforms
archetypes.sees: an umbrella name above a generic or founder-named brand
archetypes.buys_because: they already operate in the category but lack the top-level name that would consolidate it above them
archetypes.fears_losing: a competitor consolidating the category first

archetypes.label: Corporate Wellbeing & Resilience
archetypes.sees: a reframe from soft 'wellbeing' to serious 'training'
archetypes.buys_because: 'training' is methodical and outcome-oriented where 'wellbeing' is commoditized
archetypes.fears_losing: being reduced to a perk vendor

archetypes.label: Leadership Institutes & Universities
archetypes.sees: an institutional, non-sectarian name for a center on character and judgment
archetypes.buys_because: they need substance without dogma for a center on human development
archetypes.fears_losing: relevance to a generation that wants depth without doctrine

archetypes.label: Military & First-Responder Readiness
archetypes.sees: the canonical, civilian-compatible name for work they already fund
archetypes.buys_because: 'resilience training' is already their language and this is its clean name
archetypes.fears_losing: nothing operationally — but the name dignifies and unifies existing programs

archetypes.label: Sports & Mental Performance
archetypes.sees: a category name for 'the inner game' owned by no single athlete or method
archetypes.buys_because: the space needs a name that outlives any one personality or system
archetypes.fears_losing: their edge to a rival that names the space first

archetypes.label: EdTech & Youth Development
archetypes.sees: a warmer, broader frame than the politically loaded 'character education'
archetypes.buys_because: they want to win the framing of what development is for
archetypes.fears_losing: the framing war over the purpose of education

decision_lenses.question: If I don't own this, who does — and what does that cost me?
Could this become the name people say instead of what I currently call myself?
Is this cheaper to own than to compete against?
